purpose: Evaluate candidate mappings from recorded odor-context and airflow state into a goal-direction representation before any candidate is allowed to control navigation.

odor_gated_upwind.description: When odor context is present, encode the allocentric upwind direction derived from recorded body heading and body-frame airflow; when odor is absent, emit no new goal update.

odor_weighted_wind_memory.description: Sensitivity-only exponential memory of odor-weighted upwind vectors.
odor_weighted_wind_memory.selection_status: sensitivity-only; may not replace primary based on navigation score

persistent_goal_update.description: Sensitivity-only hold-last-goal policy across temporary odor loss, updated only on subsequent odor-context events.
persistent_goal_update.selection_status: sensitivity-only; may not replace primary based on navigation score

airflow_rule.source: recorded wind_x_body, wind_y_body plus recorded body heading
airflow_rule.forbidden: using source direction to resolve wind sign or angle

selection_rule: The zero-fit odor-gated-upwind encoder is primary before E003a execution. Memory-based variants are sensitivity analyses only unless a later preregistered experiment independently justifies promotion.
claim_boundary: E003a qualifies only an explicit sensory-to-goal representation adapter. It does not establish that FC2 physiology implements that adapter, that the full MaleCNS circuit navigates, or that intact wiring outperforms rewires.
